hero.label: About Armat
hero.title: We are here so that Armenian lives on.
hero.description: Armat was founded by diaspora Armenians who know well how fragile a mother tongue is when it is not spoken at home. We make learning Armenian structured, joyful and accessible.

story.label: Our story
story.title: Born from the desire to preserve what is most precious.
story.p1: Armat was born out of necessity. Our founders — diaspora Armenians from across four continents — watched as Armenian fluency declined with each passing generation. Schools were too far. Teachers were scarce. Schedules didn't fit.
story.p2: So we built Armat: a premium, structured, live online school where children anywhere in the world can learn Armenian with professional teachers, in small groups, at a pace that works for their family.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.description: To provide every Armenian diaspora child with access to world-class native language education, regardless of where they live in the world.

vision.title: Our vision
vision.description: A world where every Armenian child grows up fluent in their ancestral language and deeply connected to their 1,600-year-old cultural heritage.

values.title: Our values
values.description: Quality, authenticity, accessibility, and deep respect for the Armenian written tradition. We believe language is identity — and identity should never be lost.

method.label: Our method
method.title: A proven path from beginner to fluency.
method.description: Our structured seven-step approach ensures no student falls through the cracks — every child is seen, heard, and supported at every stage of their journey.

assessment.title: Level assessment
assessment.description: Every new student completes a short placement assessment so we understand their current level and tailor the experience from day one.

learningPlan.title: Learning plan
learningPlan.description: A personalized learning roadmap is crafted for each student, setting clear goals and milestones for the weeks ahead.

liveLessons.title: Live lessons
liveLessons.description: Interactive, teacher-led live sessions held in small groups of up to 6 students — energetic, structured, and engaging.

homework.title: Homework
homework.description: Targeted homework assignments reinforce every lesson concept, building fluency through consistent daily practice.

teacherFeedback.title: Teacher feedback
teacherFeedback.description: Detailed written feedback is provided by the teacher after every assignment, highlighting strengths and areas to improve.

progressReports.title: Progress reports
progressReports.description: Parents receive transparent monthly progress reports with skill-level breakdowns and actionable recommendations.

certification.title: Certification
certification.description: Upon completing each course level, students receive an official Armat certificate recognizing their achievement.

ageGroups.question: What age groups do you teach?
ageGroups.answer: We teach children over 4 years old, teenagers, adults and seniors. Each group has a dedicated curriculum designed for their learning style and goals.

dialects.question: Do you offer both Eastern and Western Armenian?
dialects.answer: Yes, we offer full courses in both Eastern and Western Armenian, with specialized native Armenian-speaking teachers for each branch.

lessonDuration.question: How long are the lessons?
lessonDuration.answer: Standard lessons last 45 or 60 minutes, depending on the student's age and the chosen program.

platform.question: What platform do you use for live lessons?
platform.answer: We use Zoom or Google Meet, with interactive whiteboard and screen-sharing tools.

reschedule.question: Can I reschedule or cancel a lesson?
reschedule.answer: Yes, you can reschedule or cancel a lesson at least 24 hours in advance without any penalty.

commitment.question: Is a long-term commitment required?
commitment.answer: No, no long-term commitment is required. You can choose flexible monthly plans or lesson packages and stop at any time.

sections.heading: 1. Introduction
sections.body: Armat Academy (“Armat”) operates the online Armenian learning platform available at armat.school. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use and protect your personal data when you use our services.

sections.heading: 2. Services
sections.body: We provide live individual and group Armenian lessons, self-paced courses and supplementary learning materials through our website and connected communication tools.

sections.heading: 3. Payments
sections.body: All lesson packages are prepaid. We accept Stripe and other supported payment methods. Prices are displayed in the currency shown at checkout and may be subject to applicable taxes.

sections.heading: 4. Refunds
sections.body: Packages are eligible for a full refund within 30 days of purchase if no more than one lesson has been used. Requests submitted after this period are considered individually.

sections.heading: 5. Privacy
sections.body: We collect and process only the personal data necessary to provide our services, including your name, email address, payment details and lesson history. We do not sell your personal data to third parties.

sections.heading: 6. Governing law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Armenia. Any dispute related to the use of our services will be resolved within the jurisdiction of the courts of Armenia.
